description: This file defines the 'AnyOf' validation rule class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends an abstract composite rule class and specifies the use of Respect Validation's 'AnyOf' rule class to implement composite validation logic.

classes.name: AnyOf
classes.description: A validation rule class that represents a composite 'any of' condition, allowing validation against multiple rules where at least one must pass.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the underlying validation rule from the Respect Validation library.
